status.text: The Lean-first slice is accepted. The current work is the compact mandate and slicing audit, with no open blocker.

vertical-cut.text: There is one remaining implementation task and one runnable: insert-active from the released archive across every required layer.

surface-map.text: The map binds Lean authority, on-chain substrate and edge, off-chain builders, conformance, product packaging and every derived copy.

implementation-sequence.text: One Opus owner commits the red bundle, then boot and approvals, the edge and refusals, the packaged command and copies, with one decision record at every acceptance line.

verification-and-senior-review.text: Grok and Codex author the C I table. A mute persistent senior vets decisions without rerunning gates, may add existing C I rows, and may escalate a wrong requirement. Push waits for every approval and one ticket-owner Gate S run.

release-and-remainder.text: Day zero is version zero point seven point zero. The epic owner tags the edge release after merge. At the wall, keep only a complete boot, edge and packaged command cut and state any remainder.
